The '''Oradin Diamond''' was a garish medal designed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lon Isoto]] to commemorate the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing's]] role in protecting [[Oradin]] during the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]]. It was only awarded once, to all members of the 181st&mdash;including Isoto himself&mdash;except for [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] and [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] who were instead given the [[Vuultin Starburst]] and declined any reward respectively. The award was a dubious honor given its creator's infamy.
